item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera collects a drop of pond water and a pinch of moist soil mixed in water for her class project. Under a microscope she sees many tiny moving beings, but she can see nothing in these samples with her unaided eye. What should she conclude about these tiny moving beings?

options.A: They are microorganisms, because they are living beings too small to be seen with the unaided eye.
options.B: They are not microorganisms, because the pond water and soil look like plain dirt to the unaided eye.
options.C: They are not microorganisms, because microorganisms are found only in water and never in moist soil.
options.D: They are not microorganisms, because anything that moves under a microscope must be a non-living particle.
